summary: ArcelorMittal filed a Form 6-K attaching its first quarter 2026 earnings press release. The release covers quarterly financial results, safety metrics, EBITDA per tonne, working capital, and capital allocation including dividends and share buybacks. There is no mention of an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private, restructuring, or any other special-situations event. This is a routine earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation.
